visual.description: Multi-item horizontal bar chart with three data points. Bar 1: 'Used clothing' — 34.2 ng/g (Accent Pink). Bar 2: 'New clothing' — 17.7 ng/g (Accent Blue). Bars grow left-to-right with 6-frame stagger. Below bars: two callout cards. Card 1: Baby sock icon + '90.6% BPA detection rate in infant socks' (Negative Red border). Card 2: Shock stat — '52,967 ng/g' in JetBrains Mono large + 'Chinese underwear' label. This last stat gets a brief glow pulse for emphasis.
visual.sourceText: Source: ACS study; Jurikova et al., 2024

notes: Closing scene of BPA section. Three data reveals in sequence: bars → infant socks → Chinese underwear shock stat. The 52,967 number is the section's climax — hold it for at least 2 seconds. Crossfade into Microplastic section.
